# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 2: Brains and Neural Networks**

A real look at how brain cells work, and how computer scientists copied the idea to build AI.

We will act out a neural network as a class, watch one learn on screen, and train our own. Then we will see how the same idea works inside AI that sees pictures and AI that writes.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Explain how a brain cell (neuron) sends a signal
* Explain how practice changes the brain
* Explain how an artificial neuron copies that idea
* Train a neural network and watch it learn
* Explain how AI sees pictures and how a chatbot picks its next word
